name: Co-reference_Benchmark
description: A dataset for evaluating coreference resolution systems: it measures a model's ability to identify and cluster mentions that refer to the same entity across text. Tasks typically require span detection and linking of mentions into coreference chains. Metrics focus on clustering quality and coreference F1.
reputation: A niche, task-specific dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited adoption compared to major coreference benchmarks (e.g., OntoNotes/CoNLL).
